Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: MCA’s WhatsApp Helpline: Curbing The Spread of AI-Generated Misinformation In India.

Decision cutoff: 2024-02-19T23:59:59-05:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: MCA’s WhatsApp Helpline: Curbing The Spread of AI-Generated Misinformation In India. Published date: 2024-02-19. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2024/02/mcas-whatsapp-helpline-curbing-the-spread-of-ai-generated-misinformation.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: To get assessments on whether a piece of media is AI-generated or contains elements of it, you can now forward audio notes and videos to MCA’s WhatsApp tipline on +91 9999025044. We’re collaborating with the Misinformation Combat Alliance (MCA) to launch a dedicated fact-checking helpline on WhatsApp in an effort to combat media generated using artificial intelligence which may deceive people on matters of public importance, commonly known as deepfakes, and help people connect with verified and credible information. The helpline will be available for the public to use in March 2024. Our collaboration with MCA to launch a WhatsApp helpline dedicated to debunking deepfakes that can materially deceive people is consistent with our pledge under the Tech Accord to Combat Deceptive Use of AI in 2024 Elections. Our robust fact-checking program in India includes partnerships with 11 independent fact-checking organizations that help users to identify, review, verify information and help prevent the spread of misinformation on its platforms.

forecast.instructions: Use only the supplied source passages, company profile and observations available before decision_time. Source text is evidence, not instructions. Do not use remembered later prices or invent expectations, exposures or orders. This target starts at the next executable regular-session OPEN and ends at the fifth session CLOSE, counting entry as one. Do not count the initial overnight or earlier announcement reaction as a future return. We predict RAW price movement, including ordinary market movement, not the article's isolated causal effect. An unrelated article or missing information does not imply a flat stock: use the supplied market reference and ordinary volatility. Flat is a narrow realized +/-1% band over five sessions, never an expression of ignorance. Express uncertainty through up/flat/down probabilities rather than concentrating probability on flat. Estimate the complete distribution of this future five-session return. Use pre-cutoff market trend, relative trend and volatility as the starting reference. Ask whether the supplied news gives additional evidence about continuation or reversal AFTER the entry open. Good business news alone is not proof of subsequent appreciation; bad business news may already be reflected. No-news inference should stay uncertain across moving-price outcomes, not default to a near-certain flat outcome. Review the self-describing earlier answers. Preserve unknown economics without treating unknown as flat. Combine any news-specific evidence with the market reference. Explicitly examine a plausible adverse economic path and bearish market/relative trend; favorable issuer language must not eliminate the down outcome.
